levels.title: Old Quarry
levels.prompt: Create exactly ONE unique entire 2D side-view pixel-platformer game level cross-section in ONE landscape image. Requested 1536 x 864 pixels, 16:9, or the largest landscape image possible. Show a complete room from heavy enclosing cave roof to thick lower terrain, with generous clear air above the highest playable landing and every landmark fully inside the canvas. No titles, numbers, labels, text, UI, diagram arrows, panels, grid, contact sheet, collage, or cutaway inset. Orthographic side view only: all standing surfaces are horizontal and all ladders visibly join two surfaces. Meticulous dark mossy pixel art like a detailed atmospheric indie platformer: crisp discrete pixel clusters and limited painterly dithering, dark navy and indigo recesses, thick irregular stone masses, restrained dusty moss, frost-blue mineral highlights and snowy ledge caps, little amber lanterns, finely drawn worn wood, roots, stonework, rope and ladders. Keep the architecture visually clear and uncluttered. Build a broad dry lower entry planting court, a readable main ascent with broad rest landings, a separate connected secondary return loop, and two quiet reachable cache nooks. Walking and simple jumping should visually connect the paths; do not scatter disconnected floating platforms. Include just ONE tiny gardener at the dry entry court, about 24 pixels high or 3% of the full image height, for scale, never a large foreground character. This level is COMPLETELY UNDERGROUND: continuous enclosing cave rock across the upper and side edges, no outdoor sky, moon, stars, clouds, distant mountains, surface opening or exterior landscape. The image should feel like one designed playable level, not a vague background illustration. An old frozen quarry cavern with great hewn slate steps and blue crystalline seams. An asymmetric staircase of broad mined-stone terraces climbs from the lower-left entry court toward an upper-right quarry shelter. Build a middle crossing around one old timber quarry gantry and modest suspended chain machinery, supported by thick stone piers. Blue crystals stay embedded in recesses away from standing surfaces. The secondary route runs through a low stone gallery with timber ladders returning to the central terraces. Two modest crate caches occupy recessed warm lantern alcoves. The main silhouette is massive carved stepped rock, not a castle or ordinary series of identical arches. Snow and frost settle on cold ledges while the entry court remains dry, moss-edged and welcoming.
